current_bottleneck: The remaining deployability blocker is localized regime/horizon/cell occupancy, not global width or persistent scenario collapse. Both 510a and 555a pass layer3 persistent severe undercoverage but miss sparse regime cells, especially turbulent h30 cell [2,3].
last_result_summary: 557a ideated from 556a plus recent routed-expert/frequency/exogenous-generator literature. The transferable idea is not a large new architecture; it is training-time specialization for sparse hard states. The recommended next experiment is hard-state replay: compute calibration-only undercoverage/stress miss scores from the frozen 510a source and fine-tune the same empirical-normal-score core with patch-energy style loss reweighted toward hard states.
next_step_recommendation: Implement a training-only hard-state replay patch-energy fine-tune from 510a. It must use only pre-validation calibration futures to define hard weights, store no evaluator-time cell tables, and keep inference as a learned generator.
current_best_note: 392a, 510a, and 555a all score 8/11 and fail coverage, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. 555a is useful evidence for local factor conditioning but is not a new best because its risk-readiness regime worst cell is 0.385 versus 510a's 0.538.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
